query:
SELECT 
                        id, 
                        email, 
                        first_name, 
                        last_name, 
                        role as "role: Role", 
                        created_at as "created_at!", 
                        updated_at as "updated_at!"
                    FROM users
                    WHERE email ILIKE $1
                        OR first_name ILIKE $1
                        OR last_name ILIKE $1
                    ORDER BY created_at DESC
                    LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3
